blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate leadership will ask President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to certify the anti-political dynasty bill as urgent, Sen. Risa Hontiveros said on Thursday. Hontiveros shared during the hearing of the Senate Ad Hoc Committee on Reinvigorate Investment and Sustainable Economic Growth (RISE) after Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) former Deputy Governor Diwa Guinigundo pointed out the need for a genuine anti-political dynasty bill. “Irerequest ng Senate leadership na bukod sa Ledac (Legislative Executive Development Advisory Council) priority ang anti-political dynasty bill, na macertify urgent din siya para sa loob nitong current session ng 20th congress ay susubukan po […]...
